abstract: In modern processor based systems, techniques of evaluating the soft error effect on register files (RF) is very important because it makes fine grained protection viable. This paper describes GBMW (Graph Based Mask Window analysis), a framework that can capture soft error masking effects accurately in register files at instruction level. Comparing with previous studies, GBMW not only considers logical masking effects, but also takes error propagation effects and error post-masking effects into account. We verify our method by using fault inject (FI) as a baseline and comparing our method with traditional ones. The results show that GBMW decreases the average error rate to 1/3 of those using traditional methods when predicting soft error masking effects. Furthermore, GBMW still has comparable running time.

articleTitle: Routing algorithm based on SPSO
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To solve the overlap problem in node selection process in order to fill the existing routing algorithms deficiencies, This paper designs a traditional Gossiping routing algorithm based on SPSO. At the same time, the paper gives the content and design steps of this algorithm. The simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively solve the problem of node selection.

articleTitle: A new method for polyphase pulse compression codes modulation recognision based on IQPF and FRFT
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the problem of typical polyphase codes recognition, an algorithm based on integrated quadratic phase function (IQPF) and fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) is proposed. Firstly, IQPF is used to estimate the chirp rate of the signals for pre classification. Then accurate identification is realized according to the spectral characteristics of the signals' FRFT. The simulation results show that the probability of correct recognition is higher than 90% when signal to noise ratio (SNR) is above −7dB.

articleTitle: Research on domain ontology of equipment technical manual
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The technical manual of complex equipment has vast text, which makes it slow for relevant staff to obtain knowledge, and then restricts efficiency. IETM is made of unstructured text or pictures, and this kind of form does not improve efficiency of obtaining knowledge radically or make use of computer to get further support. To deal with this problem, this paper researches domain ontology of technical manual. After analyzing technical manual systematically, the domain ontology which is able to provide structured text is built. The domain ontology present will promote progress of IETM.

articleTitle: A multitarget tracking before detecting algorithm with MIMO radar
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For improving MIMO radar detection probability of weak target, this paper proposes a tracking before detecting (TBD) algorithm based on successive target cancellation-dynamic programming (STC-DP). The algorithm extracts signals' sufficient statistic which is used to screens the track points and integrates signals, reducing complexity. Then in case of unknown the number of target, detect targets effectively by successive target cancellation. Complexity analysis and experiment simulation shows that the complexity decreases comprised with traditional TBD algorithm and the SNR is decreased by 5dB in the same false alarm probability and detection probability compared with the traditional detection algorithms, improving the detection performance.

articleTitle: Multi-target indoor tracking and recognition system with infrared markers for virtual reality
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Virtual reality (VR) is a computer simulation technology, which can create a virtual world to allow users to immerse in the simulated environment, and be able to interact with objects in a nature way. This paper presents an indoor tracking and recognition system to meet the interactive of multiple users in virtual reality. As we all know, tracking in real time and accurately play a vital role in VR application. Interactive VR games require data update rate above 35HZ to make players fell well. In our system, we use infrared cameras, infrared markers and image processing techniques to acquire the users' position and orientation information in real time. We describe a relatively inexpensive, but can monitor the precise location and orientation information system. In our system, cheap infrared cameras are fixed on ceiling. Every user in the environment wears an infrared LED module. The distance between any two infrared LED in a LED module is different with others. We can distinguish every user and get their precise position and orientation in real time by stereo vision theory and our recognition algorithm. This system strikes a good balance between price and capability.

articleTitle: Research on risk assessment of hand wearing devices based on analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous maturing mobile internet and the upcoming of 4G era, intelligent wearable equipments which are the next hotspot of intelligent terminal are going to enjoy more promising application prospect in future. Since hand wear equipment is becoming the mainstream of current consumption demand, risk assessment research of hand wearing devices is extremely urgent except for the core technical problems like privacy, safety, practicability and interaction. A sampling experiment on quality safety of available hand wearing devices was carried out in this paper. A risk assessment model was established. Risk assessment of hand wearing devices was studied by the analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Results show that available hand wearing devices are evaluated “middle” risk level. This study can provide references to study quality safety of hand wearing devices.

articleTitle: Coco model: A predictive model to explain interaction phenomena in social networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Online social networks have provided an effective and revolutionary approach to facilitate the information diffusion in recent years. And it is a fundamental process taking place incessantly that individuals are making decisions to retweet or ignore microblog contents exposed from their following friends. Based on the real dataset, our research shows that the adoption probability would decline over time and is influenced by interactions with other topic contents. In this paper, we propose a retweet probabilistic model based on the network structure in both spatial and temporal dimensions, and derive a predictive model, named Coco model. We simplify Coco model in a specific situation where a couple of microblogs show strong interaction mutually and other external factors could be ignored. We evaluate and compare it with several previous models in term of fitting and predicting, on the basis of the real dataset collected from Weibo which includes 1,263,988 microblog contents. Our experiment results show that the Coco model could characterize the diffusion process and explain the interaction phenomenon well, and has outstanding prediction precision. For example, the average prediction accuracy of the Coco model for 30 days is 93.58% based on hotspots from Aug. 2014 to Dec. 2015.

articleTitle: A new alignment method of spacecraft assembly based on irregular prism
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on physical problem in spacecraft assembly alignment, this paper presents a new alignment method of spacecraft assembly based on irregular prism, which provides a solution to the problem in the spacecraft development that the spacecraft assembly alignment cannot be measured due to the blockage of the alignment optical path when a cubic prism is used as the equipment reference prism. This method has been successfully and widely used in spacecraft development and achieves good results.

articleTitle: Particle filter based on context tracking algorithm for real-world hazy scenes
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Recently, a large scale air pollution problems, such as haze and fog bring challenges for target tracking in computer vision. However, most existing tracking algorithms are far from satisfactory in terms of adaptability to complex scenes and restoring the image's quality for hazy scenes. To address this issue, a particle filter based on context tracking algorithm is proposed for real-world hazy scenes. The state estimation of the particle filter and spatio-temporal context correlation are incorporated with popular dahazing algorithms. Compared with the state-of-the-art tracking algorithms, qualitative and quantitative experiment results have demonstrated that the proposed algorithm effectively achieves accurate and robust target tracking, as well as enhances the visual qualities of the restored images simultaneously.

articleTitle: On-chip fluidic assembly of multiple types of nanowires
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, nanowires of different diameters were assembled on the substrate by hydrodynamic focusing. Enveloped and positioned by the two sheath flows, the sample flow containing different nanowires were located to different lanes on the substrate, and thus different nanowires were assembled on the substrate. The hydrodynamic focusing approach is easy to control and economic.

articleTitle: An improved term weighting scheme for sentiment classification
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Supervised learning methods are widely used in text sentiment classification. To acquire high classification performance, the effective and precise term weighting scheme plays a prime and necessary role for classification system. The traditional term weighting schemes often ignore the use of the available labeling information as the prior knowledge, which results the expressed relationships between features and class labels are not accurate and adequate enough. Hence, this paper proposes a term weighting scheme which makes use of class contribution of feature terms, and obtains a scheme which takes into account the class contribution, local distribution and global distribution of feature terms. The scheme expresses the relationships between features and class labels as a class contribution degree factor which is based on posterior probability, then combines it with the factors of frequency and inverse document frequency. Compared with a series of term weighting schemes, experimental results on a widely used dataset show that the proposed scheme can significantly improve the performance of sentiment classification.

articleTitle: The research and simulation of the basic principle of active radar signal processor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The modern war played the decisive role of the precision guided weapon, the key lies in the radar seeker, and the core of the radar seeker is in the signal processor. In this paper, the basic principle of the signal processor front-end algorithm is studied. The band pass sampling theorem, digital down conversion, digital filter and digital pulse compression are introduced in this paper. And according to the principle of MATLAB simulation, the basic principle of the signal processor is studied more directly.

articleTitle: Major-auxiliary cooperative two-way relay scheme in the ground wave transmission of high-frequency communication
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the high flexibility and the large communication coverage of the high-frequency (HF) communication, it is widely used in the fields of military and civil. In view of the ground wave transmission of HF communication, the paper proposes the major-auxiliary cooperative two-way relay scheme. Its main idea is that adopting the auxiliary relay to assist the major relay for receiving two independent signals, then the major relay may decode-and-forward (DF) the information. Thus the outage performance can be improved. In this paper, we not only analysis the outage probability of the scheme which this paper proposed, but also discuss the effect of power allocation on the outage performance. Theoretical research and simulation results show that the scheme can reduce the outage probability of the ground-wave communication. And the more pairs of relay nodes in the scheme, the outage probability is lower.

articleTitle: A new low-complexity subblock segmentation method for PTS OFDM
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The algorithm of Partial Transmit Sequence (PTS) technique has high computational complexity in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system. In this paper, a new low-complexity combined subblock segmentation method for PTS OFDM is proposed. For analytic purposes, we derive computational complexity expressions for the proposed segmentation method and analyze the computational complexity of the proposed segmentation method compared with that of the random segmentation method which has the best Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR) reduction performance. The simulation results show that the PAPR reduction performance is degraded only slightly compared with random segmentation method.

articleTitle: Classification of volcanic ash cloud based on sensitivity analysis and FCM
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Volcanic ash cloud identification is a difficult issue in the classification of remote sensing image, and the accurate classification of volcanic ash cloud from remote sensing image has become a critical issue of volcano monitoring and aviation safety application. Aiming at the characteristics of remote sensing images and fuzzy C-means clustering (FCM) algorithm, a combined remote sensing classification method of volcanic ash cloud based on sensitivity analysis and FCM in which a two-dimensional spectral feature space was constructed and the pixels were further classified and clustered, has been proposed in this paper, and the cluster application experiments have been further tested with moderate resolution imaging spectroradiometer (MODIS) images. The experiment results show that the method proposed can classify some small areas of volcanic ash cloud, the classification accuracy and Kappa coefficient reached 86.8% and 0.7845 respectively, and achieved good classification effect of volcanic ash cloud.

articleTitle: An algorithm for enduing and identifying the information of topological entities in 3D graphics
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Feature-based modeling is very popular in generating the shape and history of a product in a three-dimensional (3D) CAD system. In the previous studies, features are the basic unit of the models. It often needs to traverse most of the features or even all of the features to extract the information of the models. In this paper, topological entities are divided into 6 levels according to the topological relationship and sub-sketch, which in the deep level, as well as its parameters is studied as the basic unit. An algorithm for naming and identifying topological entities' full names is proposed in this paper. By using SolidWorks API (Application Programming Interface), every component is endowed a specific ID automatically and each of the topological entities needed later is endowed a full name according its level and parameters to be identified by other entities when needed. The algorithm, which can extract the information of topological entities directly instead of traversing amount of features, has been implemented in a manifold modeling system.

articleTitle: A modified fast matching pursuit algorithm based on signal energy property
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Decomposition of signals over a series of time-frequency atoms by the Matching Pursuit (MP) algorithm has found many applications in signal processing and harmonic analysis. But traditional MP algorithm, such as the method based on inner product lib, are not able to handle high-dimension signal in a reasonable memory requirement and computational time. Benefit from the best time-frequency resolution of Gabor atoms, through building new dictionaries from the over-complete dictionary exploiting the structure of the signal energy property, a novel fast MP algorithm which can reduce computation and storage requirement dramatically is proposed to solve this problem. Simulation shows that the speed of the novel algorithm is more than 100 times faster than that of the traditional MP algorithm and verifies the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A traceable approach for measuring key parameters of digital video broadcasting signals
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a traceable and practical approach to measure the modulation error ratio (MER) and the power level of digital radio frequency (RF) TV signals. We use calibrated vector signal generator and sampling oscilloscope as both reference and standard to build the MER measurement system and improve the time-base error correction algorithm to increase the accuracy simultaneously; According to the characteristic of digital RF signal which spectrum is similar to noise in a specified frequency band, we adopt an algorithm with spectrum transform and in-band integral to describe the power distribution of frequency components composing the signals. It provides distinct traceable chains between measured physical quantities and metrological benchmark. The experimental results demonstrate that this approach is feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis of tropospheric effects on spaceborne single-pass SAR interferometry
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: It is often considered that spaceborne single-pass interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) is not affected by tropospheric propagation effects, since the master and slave images are obtained almost simultaneously and needn't to resolve the problem of temporal decorrelation. However, due to the fact that slightly different incidence angles cause different propagation paths, the troposphere may result in a notable height error for single-pass InSAR systems. In this paper, the tropospheric propagation delay is divided into the common delay and the differential delay, and the corresponding height errors caused by the two delays are presented. Then, the absolute and relative height errors caused by troposphere for the flat and rough terrains are analysed using the proposed theoretical framework. Theoretical analysis shows that, when the swath width is 100km, the relative height and plane errors caused by the troposphere are 1.07m and 1.07m for the flat terrain, and 1.07m and 1.87m for the rough terrain. Moreover, comparisons between the results obtained under the two-dimensional baseline model and the three-dimensional one show that the two-dimensional baseline model is accurate enough for real data analysis with less complexity. This paper can provide some theoretical basis for the correction of the tropospheric effects in spaceborne single-pass SAR interferometry.

articleTitle: Compact ultra-wideband BPF with broad stopband using improved short-circuited coplanar waveguide multiple-mode resonator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A novel structure of miniaturized ultra-wideband (UWB) bandpass filter (BPF) with wide stopband has been proposed. By introducing defected ground structure (DGS), a short circuited coplanar waveguide (CPW) multiple-mode resonator (MMR) is constituted by a pair of improved complementary split-ring. Stepped impedance microstrip line is employed on the top plane to achieve broadband coupling and high selectivity. This configuration can obtain an UWB response between 3.1 and 11.3 GHz and a wide stopband region up to 24.2 GHz with perfect rejection characteristic of below 19.5dB. In addition, the effective overall size is less than 13mm×8mm. Design, simulation and measurement of filter prototypes are presented.

articleTitle: An improved text classification model for mobile data security testing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the view of mobile data security detection, text classification model can be realized in the application layer to detect malicious attacks. Since traditional C4.5 decision tree has the disadvantage of no considering about interaction influence between properties in attribute selection, an improved model of C4.5 decision tree based on AdaBoost algorithm is put forward. The problem in measuring the properties of the optimal weak assumptions is to be solved by introducing the weight coefficient of Boosting, which would generate an adaptive adjustment weights at the end of each iteration calculation, so as to reduce the feature subset attribute redundancy and meanwhile, improve the robustness of the classification model. Experimental results illustrate that the proposed text classification model is superior to the traditional method in terms of detection rate and classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Microstrip anti-phase Gysel power divider with unequal power division
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A microstrip Gysel power divider with unequal power division and anti-phase feature is presented in this paper. By using transmission line theory, the proposed circuit is analyzed and the design equations are derived. For verification, a 4:1 prototype operating at 3GHz is designed, fabricated and measured. The measured insertion losses at the center frequency are about -1.15 dB and -7.23dB, respectively. The measured return losses are better than -20dB from 2.85 to 3.16GHz. The measured phase difference between two output ports is 180°±6° over the range of 2.8 to 3.2GHz, which show a good agreement with the simulated ones.

articleTitle: Collaborative filtering algorithm based on denoising auto-encoder and item embedding
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An collaborative filtering algorithm based on Denoising Auto-Encoder and item embedding (CDAWE) was proposed to solve the absent analysis of item co-occurrence relation and the cold start of model parameters of the information recommendation algorithm based on Denoising Auto-Encoder. In the proposed information recommendation algorithm, users are viewed as documents and items that users have rated are viewed as terms to form the training corpus firstly. Secondly, corpus are trained by the word embedding model, getting item embeddings that imply context information. Thirdly, the Denoising Auto-Encoder neural network is constructed by using all item embeddings as the initial weight and the model parameters are gained through training. Finally, user ratings are predicted by the model and the top-N recommendation is accomplished. Experimental results on the standard dataset demonstrated that the proposed algorithm has higher recommendation accuracy compared to current mainstream algorithms.

articleTitle: A study on aircraft pitch rate signal reconstruction based on signal combination
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For modern high performance fighter with a fly-by-wire control system, pitch rate signal is the key feedback for proper damp characteristic of pitch movement. Once the signal sensor of pitch rate fail, the longitudinal dynamic characteristics of closed-loop aircraft will be obviously deteriorated, even become unstable. So it is necessary to study on the signal reconstruction method in case of failure of pitch rate sensor. Based on the flight dynamics equation, a signal reconstruction method is established by combining other key flight variables' signal. Besides, using the six-degree simulation model of a relaxed static stability fighter, simulation and calculation is conducted to prove the method effective. The result indicates that although the reconstructed pitch rate signal obtained with the designed method has almost the same shape as the real signal, there also exists additional time delay and phase lag, which makes damping ratio of closed-loop aircraft a bit lower. Generally speaking, the designed signal reconstruction method is practical.

articleTitle: Design of formed cutter for milling of the screw rotor with the tooth profile represented by discrete points
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Formed milling is one of the most commonly used methods for rough machining of the screw rotors. To design the cutter for a screw rotor with the tooth profile represented by discrete points, a numerical cutter profile generation method was proposed. Firstly, based on the coordinate relationship between the cutter and the workpiece, series of intersection planes were constructed perpendicularly to the revolving axis of the cutter, and the plane-axis intersection points can be transformed to the workpiece coordinate system. Then, one contact point within each intersection plane can be achieved by use of the Golden Section method and cubic Bernstein-Bezier interpolation. Using the same procedure, the cutter profile can be obtained which has the number of points equal with that of the intersection planes. Finally, a cutter profile was generated for the circular arc screw rotor and its maximum deviation can reach sub-micrometers. From the computation process, it also can be seen that the proposed method is also of simple computation, easy application and good generality.

articleTitle: Design and validation of a single frequency GPS software receiver acquisition and tracking method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compared with hardware receiver, the GPS software receiver has higher design flexibility, small size and low price, so it has a wide range of research prospects. In this paper, the GPS signal acquisition and tracking algorithm is studied. We use the collection and playback equipment to emulate the GPS signal and validate the acquisition and tracking algorithms. In the acquisition phase, the performance of different acquisition algorithms is compared. Theoretical analysis and simulation are made to achieve the effect of coherent integration time and non-coherent integration time on the acquisition performance. When the GPS signal is weak, the method of differential coherent integration algorithm is used to acquire the signal, and the effect is better. In the tracking phase, the theoretical analysis and simulation results showed that the second-order loop can be used to track the signal with constant phase or constant Doppler frequency or constant rate of Doppler frequency. And the results show that the navigation data is right demodulated.

articleTitle: Start-up control of automated mechanical transmission with wet clutch
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To solve the problems of poor smoothness and big frictional work in start-up of automated mechanical transmission with wet clutch. The start-up fuzzy control strategies is proposed. The precise control of clutch pressure is obtained by using optimization of fuzzy control parameter based on ant colony algorithm. The simulation and experiment results showed that the control strategy reduces the driveline shock and friction loss, improves the start-up quality effectively.

articleTitle: Parallel retrieval technology based on astronomical ontology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Addresses the needs of forefront of astronomical data management research, this paper proposes a data retrieval method combining ontology and parallel computing technologies, establishes an astronomical ontology database, explores the parallelization of ontology reasoning and retrieval process based on the ontology database, and designs the parallel retrieval system. The experimental results show that the proposed method effectively improves the efficiency of astronomical data retrieval.

articleTitle: Resource scheduling for HF reception based on improved ant colony optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Because of the many and dense signals in high frequency (HF) band, the complex electromagnetic environment and relatively limited resources, the efficiency of HF reception is not high. To solve this problem, a resource scheduling method for HF reception based on improved ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm was proposed to reach cooperative HF reception. The parameter values of the ant colony optimization algorithm was optimized based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) thought, the new pheromone update method was presented, which combines the global asynchronous feature and elitist strategy to avoid the defects of the optimization algorithm such as slowly to converge and easily to fall into local optimum. The simulation experiments showed that the algorithm mentioned is not only able to get an effective solution, but also can significantly improve the convergence speed.

articleTitle: Design and research on the test system of train comfort and stability index based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper designs a test system of train comfort and stability index based on DSP, which is composed of two parts, the upper computer and the lower computer. The upper computer completes data calculation, storage, displaying and other functions. The lower computer is based on TMS320F2812, which completes the function of vibration data acquisition, processing, displaying and transmission. The system adopts ADXL345 three axis acceleration sensor to detect the horizontal, vertical and vertical acceleration values in the course of train travel. TMS320F2812 completes the acceleration signal acquisition, analysis and processing, and calculate the train running comfort and stability index. CC2540 Bluetooth module completes the data wireless transmission, can effectively solve the wiring problem. The paper mainly introduces the software and hardware design of the lower computer in detail. The system circuit diagram, the program flow chart, the specific program section and the hardware platform are given. The system has good stability and is easy to carry. At the same time, it can be used as simple and effective quality inspection facilities. There is some warning function for hidden faults. The system has a certain theoretical and practical significance.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of web tension between two adjacent printing rollers in shaft-less drive gravure printing systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In shaft-less drive gravure printing machines, each gravure printing roller is driven by an individual servo motor. The register accuracy is an important performance indicator for gravure printing process, and it is based on the stability and accuracy of the web tension between the printing rollers. Therefore, the mathematical model of the web tension between two adjacent printing rollers is studied for the shaft-less drive gravure printing machines in this paper. According to the working principle, the tension model between two adjacent printing rollers is derived, and then it is analyzed deeply from three different aspects. Some numerical simulations are carried out to verify the tension model. It shows that the simulation results are in accord with the analysis and the established tension model is reliable.

articleTitle: Research on a kind of piezoelectric flexible amplification mechanism based on lever principle
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the piezoelectric stack displacement, this paper proposes a kind of piezoelectric flexible amplification mechanism based on lever principle with good linearity, high rotation accuracy and fast response. And the theoretical stiffness calculation is carried out, finite element model is established, the mechanism modal and displacement was calculated and simulated. Amplification ratio of the piezoelectric stack is 14.3 times close to analytical calculation. In the experiment, the displacement and velocity curve was measured by laser displacement sensor, and the frequency can reach 300Hz, which is consistent with the simulation results, so the frequency and displacement of amplification mechanism can meet the market requirements of the injection valve.

articleTitle: Generalized projective lag synchronization in fractional-order chaotic systems with unknown parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a new fractional-order chaotic synchronization with unknown parameters called generalized projective lag synchronization is proposed. The method of synchronization is a generalization of projective synchronization and projective lag synchronization. According to the stability theorem of linear fractional order systems, a suitable nonlinear fractional order controller is designed for the synchronization of different structural systems, and the updated equations of unknown parameters are given. One example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on single-phase-to-earth fault section location in coal mine high-voltage power supply system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In allusion to single-phase-to-earth fault location in coal mine high-voltage distribution network, a new scheme of fault location was proposed, which based on abrupt change of zero-sequence current and grid structure matrix using that zero-sequence current amplitude of fault lines is larger than non-fault lines. In this method, through analysis of amplitude change ratio between the fault lines and non-fault lines, and when the ratio is larger than the threshold, fault lines are determined. Fault character vector is designed according to the ratio, and then combine with the grid structure matrix to design fault message character matrix, finally locate the fault zone. The experiment results show that this method can achieve vertical selective grounding protection of high-voltage power grid of coal mine.

articleTitle: Current reckoning method to identify overlapping bad data and branch state in state estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The current reckoning method is modeled by alternating current branch model, at the same time, the current reckoning network model is established[1]. Based on the current measurements, the link reckoning technology is used to obtain the reckoning current, and then achieve the identification, current difference, to mine its identification characteristics in the presence of undesirable measurements in state estimation. After that, the branch state can be judged based on the current information which excludes the bad data interference, thus obtaining the actual operation structure of the network. In this paper, the current reckoning method is used to modify the current measurement set, and the branch state change of the system is judged, the coexistence of bad data and branch state change is further analyzed.

articleTitle: Height control method of multi — Rotor vehicle based on auto-Disturbance-rejection control
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the non-direct measurement disturbances caused by the ground effect on the high-stability control of the aircraft at low altitude, it introduced a design of the height control system based on auto-disturbance rejection control technology in this paper. The use of auto-disturbance-rejection technology can be independent of the precise mathematical model of the aircraft system, which can be applied after determining the order of the controlled system by means of experimental determination and system identification. It provided the technical support for the application of unmanned aerial platforms in low-altitude operations by observing and feedforward compensating for the negative effects caused by turbulence disturbances on the height of the aircraft, which greatly improved the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle's altitude control when it is flying at low altitude.

articleTitle: DC splitting for transmitter power limit low pass channel information and power transfer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we study a transmitter power limit low pass channel information and power transfer system for ammunition data link. A DC splitting architecture where a DC signal is used for power transfer and several OFDM subcarriers are used for information transfer is designed for the system. The DC and OFDM power allocation problem for maximizing the information transfer rate is proposed and constraints of power splitter leakage, DC/DC narrowband noises, transmitter available power, maximum receiver security and minimum receiver sustainable power are taken into account. Lagrange multiplier algorithm is used for solving the constrained convex optimization problem. Simulation result shows that the optimal power allocation can be gotten under the proposed design. The sub-bound of the transmitter available power and the up-bound of active bandwidth of the proposed architecture are calculated by using the algorithm.

articleTitle: Preliminary research on measurement system for micro liquid volume
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For measurement of micro liquid volume, researchers are mainly using the gravimetric method. The volume of liquid is obtained by measuring the mass density of liquid. ISO 8655 proposed the non-gravimetric method based on photometric method, which makes the method for measuring micro liquid volume become a new trend of development. In order to meet the requirements of online measurement, and overcome the effect of evaporation when we use the gravimetric method to measure, this paper puts forward a liquid volume measurement method based on laser and machine vision. Through the establishment of volume table of glass gauge, we measure the liquid level inside the glass gauge, and get micro liquid volume dissolved in glass gauge. Measurement system use the cross laser and the high resolution CCD camera, with image processing technology and extract characteristic elements, to realize the high precision measurement of micro liquid volume in the glass gauge. And we have a comparison test with static measuring method, further determine the measurement accuracy of the device. For 100ml gauge, measurement error is less than 0.15 ml. With the optimization of the system devices, measurement accuracy can be further improved.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency optimization for multi-relay cooperative network based on node fairness
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the cooperative relay network, how to improve the energy efficiency of the communication is a very important problem. Further, since user nodes have limited energy, it is necessary to consider fairness of cooperative relay network under the prerequisite of guaranteeing the average use time of all nodes. In this paper, we propose a relay node feedback function, and uses it to show degree of selfishness of the candidate nodes. According to the function, a strategy for relay selection and power allocation optimization based on the weighted fair energy is put forward. The results shown that the proposed method in the system significantly improves the inter-node energy consumption question of unfairness, the average energy consumption per load relay to each node, and finally to the energy balance of the entire network.

articleTitle: Folding mechanism design and analysis of high-altitude gliding UUV wings
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: High-altitude gliding unmanned underwater vehicles (HAGUUVs) are released in high attitude and works in water after a short glide in the air. According to the High-altitude Gliding UUV airborne emission requirements, the folding mechanism of wings of the HAGUUV is desighed. On the basis of mechanics analysis of the organization, the dynamics modeling of organization's unfolding process is given by using Lagrange equation, and the wings unfolding movement characteristics are discussed through numerical simulation. Analysis results show that the designed folding mechanism can achieve the requirement of High-altitude gliding system performance, and provides theoretical guidance for further drop experiment.

articleTitle: Video inpainting by Markov Random Field modeling and Gibbs sampling
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Video inpainting is to recover the distorted pixels of the image sequences. In this paper, we use Gibbs distribution and Markov Random Field (MRF) modeling to solve this problem. We build MRF on the missing region of the image sequence conditioned on its neighborhood pixels that are undistorted. We recover the missing pixels by drawing samples from the MRF by Gibbs sampling. We collect a dataset to test the method. The experiments on the dataset with different types of missing pixels show that the method works well in both quantitative and qualitative aspects.

articleTitle: Fast speech keyword recognition based on improved filler model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Most traditional template matching based keyword recognition methods don't need training data, just rely on frame matching. However, the recognition speed is relatively slow and it can't be used in practice. The LVCSR-based method needs to convert the speech signal into text signal before recognition, which has an important impact on the final recognition performance. In this paper, we propose a method based on the filler model framework, which selects the syllable instead of using words as the modelling unit. The search space of our method is composed of all the syllables rather than words. By fixing a part of the Hidden Markov Model (HMM) state probability matrix parameters, our method can obtain important model parameters for a more sufficient training. Meanwhile, a two-stage model training strategy is proposed to reduce the artificial markings of training speech and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) is introduced to improve the efficiency of system identification. Experimental results show that our method can effectively improve the detection rate of keywords and achieve similar detection time under the same conditions.

articleTitle: DOA estimation performance simulations and analysis with velocity errors for a passive synthetic array using single moving sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A passive synthetic array (PSA) using a single moving sensor is formed to estimate direction of arrival (DOA). And the signal model with velocity errors is constructed. By using MUSIC algorithm, the angle estimation performance is analyzed through numerical simulations under different velocity errors. With the increase of velocity error, resolution and accuracy of multi-target angle estimation decline gradually. When errors get 10 m/s, angle estimation can't be distinguished clearly. According to the simulation result, the velocity error should not be more than 3m/s, otherwise it will cause great negative effects on the performance of multi-target angle estimation.

articleTitle: A multi-resolution medical image registration method based on intensity and point features
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The registration of medical images with local deformation is a difficult problem, especially the images to be registered not only have local deformation but also have great difference in gray-scale distribution. It is a excellent method to solve this problem by adding the Euclidean Distance Metric based on landmark points as the penalty term to the Intensity-based metric in the registration. In this paper, an improved distance measure is proposed, which makes the local deformation more accurate than the Euclidean Distance Metric. In addition, for the multi-resolution registration model, an adaptive weight of metric method for multi-resolution registration is proposed, which makes the registration results better.

articleTitle: A mixer-first receiver with a new transimpedance amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A mixer-first receiver with high linearity and low noise is presented in this paper. Since there is no low noise amplifier (LNA) between the antenna and the mixer, the passive mixer reflecting the baseband impedance makes input impedance matching directly in the receiver. The choice of the operation amplifier (OTA) and the parasitic resistance of the passive mixer both decide the noise of the receiver, and the analysis and principle is shown in the paper. The mixer-first receiver here challenges a new structure of transimpedance amplifier (TIA), which consists of a g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> stage and a TIA stage. This new structure achieves low noise and high linearity. However, this new structure has the risk of stability, and the analysis about the stability is discussed in this paper. With the core circuit consuming 135mW, the prototype receiver implemented in 180nm CMOS technology achieves >20dB conversion gain, <;6dB in-band NF and >20dBm in-band IIP3 in 1.2GHz, with 1.8V supply.

articleTitle: High-recall human abnormal behavior detection using MPEG-7 descriptor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Automated detection and recognition of human abnormal behavior is the key problem of monitoring systems. We construct a complete system that is able to alert the human operator when a knife in hand is visible in camera views. We use RealSense 3D camera to track hands, modified MPEG-7 EHD as feature vector and none-linear SVM as classifier. In this paper, we improve the feature extraction algorithm further by rotating feature vector and adding MGES feature methods, which are validated on the public knife detection database. Our hand knife detection algorithm achieves a considerable recognition accuracy of 92% and recall rate of 94.7%, increasing by 1% and 17% respectively, compared with similar studies. This improvement is pretty significant in strict security applications, which requires high recall and low false negative rate.

articleTitle: A crosstalk optimization method for dual-band DDS frequency source
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the current development direction of frequency source and its application field, the advantages and difficulties in realization of dual-band frequency source are analyzed in this paper. A dual-band DDS system of digital receiver is chosen as an analytic object. The causes and mechanisms of the crosstalk problem are demonstrated, and a general method for crosstalk optimization is proposed. By this method, the system is able to achieve the performance requirements under the circumstances that two bands work at the same time. The emphasis of this paper is the analysis on causes of crosstalk and crosstalk optimization of dual-band frequency source.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of bubble flow of gas and oil phase in high speed rolling bearing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For high speed rolling bearing, the bubble flow calculation model is constructed based upon two-body fluid model and liquid phase turbulent flow model, in which effect of bubble diameter and size of the bubble, and the bubble breakup and coalescence model are considered. The numerical study reveals the relationship between cavitation ratio of bubbles, inlet speed of lubricant, bearing speed and pressure at outlet. It is found that breakup bubbles will be more and more in high speed condition when the initial bubble diameter is bigger, and temperature rising of bearing will be higher. In the gas phase, there exists an optimal value for cavitation ratio of bubbles, such that the temperature rise of the bearing reaches the lowest value.

articleTitle: Research on improvement of filtering process in filtered backprojection reconstruction algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Filtered back projection reconstruction algorithm is commonly used in CT image reconstruction algorithm, in which the filtering process has a great impact on the quality of image reconstruction. Aiming at the problem of low reconstruction precision and long operation time on the present commonly used filter, the existing filter is improved in this paper. The hybrid filter R-L&W-Lewit is designed which is an average of near 3 points on Lewit filter and is weighted with the R-L filter. Not only does the side-lobe oscillation of the filter decrease, but the main lobe height also increases. In this paper, we also study the feasibility for the filtered back projection algorithm by using Hartley transform to replace the Fourier transform, and use the fast Hartley algorithm to calculate the filter convolution process. The experimental results show that the new filter has high precision and good noise suppression and the effect is better than that the traditional filter. The fast Hartley algorithm can obtain similar reconstruction precision with the traditional fast Fourier algorithm, and the speed of operation has been improved obviously.

articleTitle: Linear frequency diversity array synthetic aperture radar imaging with enhanced fast back-projection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the model of linear frequency diversity array synthetic aperture radar (LFDA-SAR) multiple carrier frequency (MCF) signal, the space-variant range offset characteristic of the echo is derived in detail and an enhanced fast back-projection algorithm is proposed. By splitting the original SAR data matrix into sub data blocks, sub image formation and sub image combination recursively, EFBPA effectively rectify the image defocus, geometric distortion problems in traditional back-projection imaging results and greatly reduces the computational complexity of BPA. All results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Modelling of fuze electromagnetic scattering echo
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Fuze echo is an important factor affecting fuze-warhead matching efficiency. Based on the combination of physical optics algorithm and method of equivalent currents, the modeling of near-field echo of extended target was built. A typical encounter model of missile and target was taken as example to study the change of target echo under different irradiation conditions. From the analysis of the results, the local irradiation of target near-field has a great influence on the amplitude of echo. The effect of extended target leads to the aberration of Doppler's frequency, without changing its total trend. The conclusion provides a new idea of design for optimizing fuze-warhead matching plan and determining the best time of detonation.

articleTitle: Research of ROHC for PoC service based on 3G cellular network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: PoC is a group communication service using VoIP technology based on 3G cellular network packet domain carrier. ROHC can complete the header compression in PS domain of 3G network, which can improve the efficiency of wireless transmission. This paper analyzes the working principle and the operation modes of ROHC, designs the processing of the compressor and decompressor. Simultaneity an improved algorithm applied to the U mode is presented against PoC service features, with great benefits on cost and quality of service (QoS).

articleTitle: Concurrent interaction model of distributed monitoring system based on agent
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the new application demands of distributed monitoring system, the hardware and software equipment of one or more monitoring position was abstracted as a distributed agent; central server was canceled, the system level management functions were shared by one or more agent flexibly. Agents used point-to-point communication; the interaction driver which was based on the state of agent was realized by Subscribe/ Publish mode. The state and monitoring data of each agent were interacted in real-time in the system. Concurrent technology based on multi-core processor was used to design concurrent algorithm and optimize the communication ability and data processing ability of each agent. A real monitoring system was built to test the interactive function and the concurrent performance of the agent. Test result shows that the interaction model can meet the requirements of data synchronization and management functions in the system. The application of concurrent technology and algorithm can improve the performance of the system effectively and ensure the real-time performance of the system.

articleTitle: Path search of intelligent car based on graphplan
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Computer has been widely used and fully researched along with the progress of electronic technology. We are no longer satisfied with simple calculation in computer application, but expect they can replace the human brain to accomplish complex work. So the artificial intelligence has emerged. There is a very classic research topic in the history of artificial intelligence - Intelligent Planning. IJCAI has hold the meetings about intelligent planning and scheduling once every two years since 1998 and the article about intelligent planning has accounted for a quarter in AAAI-99 and IJCAI-99. This paper will solve the problem of path search of intelligent car through graphplan to search path more and more intelligently, So we can save time and improve efficiency. The technology of graphplan has been proposed by Blum and Furst in 1995 and caused a great sensation in the history of intelligent planning. It is no longer taking the theorem, formula for planning and studying, but using the “Graph” instead. So some action can be executed in parallel and efficiency of plan can be greatly improved by using the method of graphplan to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of living streaming system based on multi-service nodes collaboration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a design and implementation method of living streaming system based on multi-service nodes collaboration. The system uses the entropy weighting method to dynamically determine the weight factor of each service node and uses the coordinator node to collect the load information of service nodes and perform global optimal distribution of loads. The collection terminal uses RTMP (Real Time Messaging Protocol) as the push protocol to send videos to service nodes, which then transcode the received videos into HLS (HTTP live streaming) and forward them to the releasing nodes in real time. Users can watch live videos on the releasing nodes. This service model is particularly suitable for watching live videos on mobile terminals. Herein, the design and implementation of the proposed system is described and its feasibility and effectiveness are verified in actual network environments.

articleTitle: Design of USB-UART interface converter and its FPGA implementation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we present a UART-USB interface converter design based on FPGA, which implements asynchronous serial communication protocol and USB protocols conversion. Design is implied by Hardware Description Language using modular design, it can be integrated into different SoC system. After Modelsim functional simulation and FPGA simulation with two computers, we verify the feasibility of the design.

articleTitle: A novel DOA estimation algorithm for a 5-element circular array
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Under the influence of the radome of the active and passive radar, the uniform circular array (UCA) becomes non-uniform in the electromagnetic performance, so the accuracy of direction of arrive (DOA) estimation is not high. This paper presents a universal look-up table algorithm for 5-element circular array to solve the problem. Firstly, we traverse the view field of the radar to obtain the long baseline phase differences of each angle point and store them to obtain the lookup table. Then, we can solve the incoming signal's long baseline phase differences on the array and compare them with the phase differences stored in the lookup table according to the maximum cosine value criterion. Finally, we can get the closest point and the corresponding angle is the angle of the incoming signal. Numerical simulation results and experimental results verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A new type of fault current limiter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Power grid scale is expanding, more generators with large capacity are used in the power system, the growth of the load current is rapidly, the realization of the major regional power grid interconnection, all of these factors will lead to the fault current level continues to rise, which may lead to serious security problems, even collapse and collapse of the system. This paper proposes a high-speed switch type topology structure of current limiter, the application of the latest high-speed switching technology of current limiter, can effectively solve the problem of controller devices such as work power. First of all, we introduce and analyze its current limiting principle and its way to obtain energy. Secondly, we make detailed introduction on installation location of the application of current limiter. Then we analyze current limiter in the different voltage grade of power grid theoretically. Finally, we make mathematical calculation analysis and simulation on the current limiting effect of the high-speed switching current limiter and prove the validity and rapidity of the method in this paper. The new type of current limiter can also improve its ability of open circuit, prolong its service life, and eliminate its application in the process of some of the adverse influence on the grid.

articleTitle: From Euclid division of constant integers to Zhang division of time-varying variables
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Static Euclid division has been studied for many decades. In this paper, we focus on time-varying division (or termed, Zhang division). As Zhang dynamics (ZD) and gradient dynamics (GD) have shown powerful abilities to solve a great variety of time-varying problems, we present a ZD model and a GD model for time-varying division by defining a Zhang function and an energy function, respectively. Through illustrative examples, the efficacy of the presented ZD and GD models for online solution of time-varying division is substantiated effectively. In addition, division-by-zero (DBZ) problem is solved readily in this paper, which is well understood.

articleTitle: Impact of radio over fiber technology for integrated 5G front and back-haul applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The future vision of integrating back and front-haul in 5G mobile networks requires the designing of high capacity network transport architecture, enabling flexible management service with high fidelity. This paper presents an approach of using Radio over Fiber technology for 5G back and front-haul applications. The proposed design was verified using co-design photonics method to investigate the performance and reliability for long-haul transmission. Our design shows better performance at high data rate, which can significantly increase the system capacity for 5G-radio access and core network functions, due to the use of low cost optoelectronic components for data transport. This approach will play a major role for future 5G integrated transport system designs, since it is the evolution of coexisting 4G network architecture.

articleTitle: Wideband band-pass filter with defected ground structure
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new type of wideband band-pass filter based on DGS structure is investigated with simulation in this paper. The filter is based on the SIW structure. In order to obtain advantages of compact structure and good performance, DGS and defected microstrip structure are adopted. The filter has the advantages of small size and easy integration. CST Microwave studio software is used to simulate the proposed filter. From the simulation results, the filter center frequency is 16.4GHz, fractional bandwidth is 68.3%, and the return loss is less than -10dB.

articleTitle: Simple approach to reduce the number of selected intra luminance prediction modes for RDO computation in AVS2
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The second generation Audio-video Coding Standard (AVS2) is the latest video standard currently under the development of Audio-video Coding Standard (AVS) Workgroup of China for achieving higher coding efficiency than previous (AVS1). In intra luminance prediction of AVS2, the AVS2 video encoder has to compute the rate-distortion optimization (RDO) of 9 selected candidate prediction modes in order to determine the best luminance prediction mode, which is a time-consuming work. In this paper, a simple approach is proposed for reducing the number of candidate prediction modes to equals or less than 6, where the video encoding experiments based on Reference Design (RD) 14.0 program with the AH-Intra configuration have demonstrated that the proposed method can averagely decrease the video encoding time by 29.37%, at a cost of Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR) degradation of 0.05dB.

articleTitle: Relation extraction via deep-fusion convolution neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional single neural network method is limited in feature dimension extraction, a new deep-fusion convolutional neural network is proposed. It uses two kinds of different representations (i.e., word vector and shortest dependency path) as different inputs of convolutional neural network, therefore, it is capable to learn more dimension text features automatically and fuse them deeply in high dimensional feature space and then it improves the accuracy of relation extraction. Experiments are conducted on the SemEval-2010 Task 8 data sets, the results show that the proposed relation extraction method based on deep-fusion convolutional neural network can effectively combine the traditional text features and high dimensional features of neural network learning, and improves the effectiveness of relation extraction.

articleTitle: MapReduce based named entity recognition for biology literature
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of biology, its relevant literature will be more and more important for researchers to dig out more valuable knowledge. Named Entity Recognition (NER) for biology literature is a very common and important task in these works. With the increase of the literature amount, the recognition speed becomes slower and less accurate. In order to tackle this problem, a MapReduce based NER is used to reduce the running time by leveraging parallel processing. Experimental results show that the application of entity naming recognition to the MapReduce framework has greatly improved in the CRF model training process and entity recognition process. Name entity recognition is accommodated to parallel framework to solve recognition problem rapidly and accurately.

articleTitle: Robust wideband beamforming based on response variation constraint
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the tapped delay-lines (TDL) wideband model, the response variation (RV) constraint is applied to improve the frequency response consistency of the wideband beamforming. The optimization criterion of the proposed algorithm is minimizing the designed sidelobe level utmost and the constraints of the sidelobe level, interference suppression and the response variation while making the direction response of the desired signal approaches the unity response. In addition, the proposed algorithm does not require pre-steering delay compensation, and can be solved effectively with the interior-point method. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain corking constant beamwidth performance, suppress the interference, and increase the output signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR).

articleTitle: Research on the evolution law of the semantic web structure of online shopping reviews
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to explore the semantic clues and online shopping consumer behavior rules contain online shopping commentary, this paper takes 55560 after-sales evaluation as the research object to put forward the netizens related hypothesis evaluation of social network evolution, and evaluation of innovation of Internet users social network evolution diagram visualization description and empirical analyses. The study found that, the commodity “quality”, “practical”, “the seller” “attitude” attribute has a high center, and consumers rely on degree bigger to merchandise the four attributes; the highest correlation between utility and quality of goods in the commodity attribute of CO word matrix; the whole network density of consumer evaluation is relatively large, suggesting that it on the online shopping attitude and behavior will have a great impact. Therefore, this study finally reveals the social network online shopping reviews the evolution process and the consumer behavior evolution characteristics.

articleTitle: The vibration analysis for transformer winding based on multi-field coupling
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Mathematical models for DC bias vibration analysis of the transformer winding are developed. The model is combined into multi-physical field coupling modeling for vibration analysis of the transformer. By applying the primary voltage as excitation and under different DC bias, vibration of the transformer winding is simulated and analyzed. The simulation results verify the method which is proposed transformer magnetic vibration field coupling analysis with dc bias is effective.

articleTitle: Multi-target flight scene simulation based on STK/X
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to simulate the whole process of ballistic missile flight, and make the observation of the ballistic target flight better, a multi-target flight scene simulation system is designed using MATLAB and STK in this paper. The related concepts of STK software and the method of multi-target trajectory simulation are introduced. At the same time, the micro-motion characteristics of the ballistic target are analyzed. The multi-target flight scene generation and visualization are realized.

articleTitle: Software defect prediction based on geometric mean for subspace learning
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the confusion of fault-prone software modules and non-fault-prone ones, and the limit of traditional mothed such as LDA and PCA, the performance of software defect prediction model is difficult to improve. In this paper, we present GMCRF, a method based on dimensionality reduction technique and conditional random field (CRF) for software defect prediction. In our proposed method, firstly, we leverage geometric mean for subspace learning to choose the best combination of features from data set. Secondly, we propose to apply the best combination of features which is selected by geometric mean-based approach in CRF model. Interestingly, we find that the GMCRF method achieves much better final results than the other approach as shown in the software defect data classification task.

articleTitle: The research of analytical approach for crosstalk of multi-conductor transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the purpose of analyzing the crosstalk of multi-conductor transmission lines, an analytical approach - the lumped parameter model method is presented. First, the physical model of multiple adjacent transmission lines is established by using the 2D field solver of the Ansoft Q3D software and the unit length electrical parameters such as capacitance matrix and inductance matrix of transmission lines are extracted. Then, the lumped parameter equivalent circuit of multiple transmission lines is established by using software ORCAD Capture. At last, the input and output voltage waveform of aggressive lines and the near-end and far-end crosstalk voltage waveform of victim lines can be obtained. This method reduces the restrictions of the structure of drivers and circuits, and it is also helpful for the realization of all kinds of simulation signal source in EMC simulation research.

articleTitle: A novel microstrip absorptive bandstop filter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A novel absorptive bandstop microstrip filter utilizing two couplers is presented in this letter. The proposed absorptive bandstop filer (ABSF) with four ports is achieved by combing two quadrature couplers with two conventional microstrip bandstop filters. Unwanted energy within the stopband will be absorbed by absorptive port instead of reflecting to incident port so that the property of absorption could be realized. The theory is analyzed and a microstrip bandstop filter with a center frequency f0 of 5GHz is demonstrated and simulated, the maximal stopband rejection is 38 dB with an input return loss of 31 dB, which implies that almost of the input power is dissipated by the proposed ABSF.

articleTitle: License plate recognition system based on the hardware acceleration technology on the ZYNQ
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the disadvantage of high cost and poor practicability of traditional license plate recognition technology based on PC, apply this technology on the ZYNQ to implement the hardware acceleration of the license plate recognition algorithm. The platform consists of programmable logic (PL)and a processing system (PS). The hardware acceleration of the algorithm of license plate location is completed through the part PL; On the PS runs the Linux system. In terms of license plate recognition algorithm, we use the edge detection algorithm, vertical projection method and template matching method respectively for the location of license plate image, character segmentation and recognition. Finally, it implement the Hardware acceleration of license plate recognition and reduce the time for the license plate recognition algorithm.

articleTitle: A multiple paths scheme with labels for key distribution on quantum key distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper establishes a probability model of multiple paths scheme of quantum key distribution with public nodes among a set of paths which are used to transmit the key between the source node and the destination node. Then in order to be used in universal net topologies, combining with the key routing in the QKD network, the algorithm of the multiple paths scheme of key distribution we propose includes two major aspects: one is an approach which can confirm the number and the distance of the selection of paths, and the other is the strategy of stochastic paths with labels that can decrease the number of public nodes and avoid the phenomenon that the old scheme may produce loops and often get the nodes apart from the destination node father than current nodes. Finally, the paper demonstrates the rationality of the probability model and strategies about the algorithm.

Author Keywords: strategy of stochastic paths with labels

articleTitle: DC power flow control in DC networks through DC/DC zero sequence blocking transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: World is moving to adopt the renewable energy sources to overcome the power issues with zero toxic emission. The key problem is to inject huge power to the grid, generating from renewable energy sources with traditional electrical equipment and grid infrastructure. Currently, work on DC networks is achieving great attention in distributed power generation system, which arise the problem related to the significance of DC power flow control in DC networks. Interline power flow controller (IPFC) are used to control of power flow in the multi-lines and parallel transmission lines. In this paper, a new topology for Interline DC Power Flow Controller (IDCPFC) based on the Zero Sequence Blocking Transformer (ZSBT) has been proposed and analyzed. In the proposed model, the buck converter works as a variable transformer and its current is regulated through the duty cycle of converter. In Comparison with pervious topologies the control algorithm is simple. To validate the topology, simulation results of proposed topology are investigated in this paper. Large-scale network has the characteristics of complex system, and its survivability is different from simple network. The current network survivability studies usually only aim for a specific network level or type, and seldom investigate survivability from a system perspective. In this paper, the concept of large-scale network survivability is defined from the perspective of complex system, the survivability association is analyzed based upon the correlation characteristics of complex system, and the structural model of large-scale network survivability association is established and its properties are analyzed. On the basis of survivability association properties, the survivability association function is defined based upon set pair analysis theory, which is utilized to characterize the survivability association degree among subsystems in large-scale network. Finally, the effectiveness of the model proposed in this paper is validated through case study.

Author Keywords: Zero Sequence Blocking Transformer (ZSBT) and Buck Converter
