articleTitle: A study on fingerprint image segmentation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A algorithm of fingerprint image segmentation is the essence of the whole fingerprint system, and this paper proposes an improved one which based on adaptive dynamic threshold segmentation algorithm. It ameliorates Otsu algorithm according to the unevenness of grey scale. This algorithm distinguishes the target from the background in the image with the combination of threshold segmentation and region segmentation, which can receive image with better effect. Experiments show that fingerprint image segmentation algorithm proposed by this article can receive good image effect.

articleTitle: Optimization analysis of distribution of RFID multi-tag based on GA-BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: One of the important advantages of RFID technology is to identify multiple targets at the same time. However, in order to identify multi-object at the same time, it is necessary to solve the problem of improving the performance of tag reading. Among the factors affecting the performance of tag identification, the geometric distribution of multi-tag is the key one. With the advantage of GA-BP neural network in optimization analysis, we do some researches about the impacts of the multi-tag's geometric distribution to the performance of reader. By training a large number of dynamic test data under the gate entrance environment, optimal RFID tag geometric distribution can be predicted by GA-BP neural network under the maximum or minimum reading distance. Furthermore, the dynamic reading performance of multi-tag system could be effectively improved.

articleTitle: The study of wind resistance testing equipment for unmanned helicopter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a wind field was designed to meet the test requirements through analyzing the experimental requirements of unmanned helicopter wind resistance. If we want to test the performance of UAV wind resistance, we have to get the wind speed at the UAV. There are two problems that we would to face, one is that it is a wind field with wind speed decay, and the other is that we want to do this experiment in which the UAV be the flying state further more the UAV does not carry instruments for measuring wind speed. We propose a method to test the wind speed where the location of the UAV in a wind field with wind speed decay for these two issues. Experimental equipment contains wind speed sensors, variable frequency fan and servo mechanism and so on. Considering the communications equipment this of this program have many type and we need a large number of such devices. Using a multi-threaded multi-serial bus-type communication, making each serial bus has a unique role.

articleTitle: Shock wave signal distributed acquisition and data processing technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: LXI(LAN Extensions for Instrument) distributed bus technology based on Ethernet had solved the problem of measurement at wide area. The test system consists of LXI bus acquisition instrument which can meet the shock wave signal test. In view of the characteristics of shock wave field such as it has many measurement points and the long acquisition time and the sampling rate. We designed the LXI bus distributed testing system. And the paper describes detailedly the composition of hardware and the framework of software. The paper does time and frequency analysis to the shock wave transient signal by wavelet transform and get the optimum decomposition level, and does the noise reduction and reconstruction process, The results show that compared with the traditional Fourier transform, this approach is easier to extract the characteristic parameters of shock wave.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation on the compatibility of ship-to-air missile and chaff centroid jamming in cooperative air-defense
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Compatibility is an important factor affecting the cooperative use of ship-to-air missile (SAM) and chaff centroid jamming. This paper established the compatibility judgment model of SAM and chaff centroid jamming based on the working principle of the two weapons, and the simulation experiment was carried out in combination with the combat background. The results show that there is a possibility that SAM and chaff centroid jamming are not compatible, and the compatibility of the two weapons is mainly related to the direction of the attack target and the launch direction of the chaff. The research results of this paper can provide reference for the automatic decision of warship air-defense.

articleTitle: Extension of lifetime with network coding in cluster based wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: How to extend network's lifetime is one of the most important problem in the Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). Network's Lifetime is directly dependent on node inside the area, especially the node nearly the sink, these nodes consumes its power very quickly to support large data stream from outside to the sink node, they takes on the heavy traffic and formed the bottleneck zone. To solve this problem, we combine linear network coding with traditional cluster WSNs. With the linear network coding, node could transmit multiple packets at one time in the bottleneck zone. In this paper, we focus on estimate the upper bounds of network lifetime with network coding and the duty-cycled. The results of the study showed that more data could be transmitted to the sink node with the same number of transmissions by the coding node, which significantly increased the energy efficiency of the whole network, reduce the traffic load of the node in the bottleneck zone, and prolong the overall lifetime of the network.

articleTitle: A data mining approach for intelligent equipment fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Mechanical and electrical equipments are widely used in industry. Existing electro-hydraulic mixing equipments mainly use expert systems for fault diagnasis. However, in order to increase the accuracy of diagnasis, the expert systems have to acquire more knowledge. And diagnosis system will bring great uncertainty due to limited knowledge. Furthermore, existing fault diagnosis system has the disadvantages of low efficiency of analyzing data, bad fault-tolerance, and this may lead to wrong diagnosis results. In this paper, Decision Tree algorithm of data mining technology is used in the area of equipment fault diagnosis, and discuss and study the method of equipment intelligent fault diagnosis based on data mining technology. As a result, this method can compensate for the limitations of knowledge acquisition of expert system and enhance the accuracy of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Face detection: A deep convolutional network method based on grouped facial part
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method is proposed for face detection, which is of simple structure but robust to severe occlusion. In detail, the size-free images are firstly segmented to a series of candidate windows. Then these candidate windows are further filtered by grouped facial part networks to generate a set of windows which may contain faces. Finally, the set of face proposals are input to a multi-task deep convolutional network (DCN) for further classification and calibration. Importantly, we take the spatial position relations of local facial parts into consideration and find it helpful to handle the severe occlusion. Our method achieves outstanding performance on the widely used datasets FDDB and AFW, compared to the other proposed face detectors. Especially on FDDB, our method achieves a high recall rate of 90.13%.

articleTitle: Euler-precision ZED formula 3NgPED_G extended to future minimization with theoretical guarantees and numerical experiments
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose and investigate a new Euler-precision 3-node g-proportional finite difference formula [also named Zhang finite difference (ZFD) formula 3NgPFD_G], which achieves an error pattern of O(g), where g denotes the sampling gap. Moreover, the proposed formula is extended to future minimization (FM). Specifically, the ZFD formula 3NffPFD_G and its extension to discretize continuous-time Zhang neural network (CTZNN) model for solving FM are first of all put forward. Secondly, the ZFD formula 3NgPFD_G is proved to effectively approximate the 1st-order derivative by Taylor expansion, and results of discrete-time Zhang neural network (DTZNN) model for solving FM are obtained by adopting the formula above to discretize the CTZNN model. Finally, expository numerical approximation and discretization experiments are conducted and analyzed to illustrate the efficacy and superiority of the ZFD formula 3NgPFD_G and its extension to FM.

articleTitle: Research on software defect localization technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Software defect localization is an important step in the process of fixing defects and is a necessary means to improve software quality. In the process of fixing defects, it is also the most time-consuming and laborious task to accurately locate the files where the defects should be fixed. In order to clarify the research progress in the field of defect localization, we introduce the key technologies and problems of software defect localization in recent years, and classify the various localization methods, point out the research hotspot and direction in future.

articleTitle: Adaptive system construction of medical knowledge agent learning technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Advanced learning techniques and enhanced learning techniques based on big data that have been applied to a wider range of medical fields. In this paper, Agent technology and reinforcement learning technology are combined, and an adaptive system based on agent reinforcement learning is proposed. This system supports the continuous interaction between agent and environment, and improves the self-adaptability of knowledge learning system.

articleTitle: An improved RGB-D SLAM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents 2 improvements to traditional RGB-D SLAM algorithm. One is to build a minimum error function using graph optimization model to estimate camera pose, reduce the number of iterations; another is proposed a intelligent loop detection algorithm which according to camera trajectory curvature, to construct accurate loop closing. We also design the lost recovery system and use GPU in feature extraction. Compared with the tradition RGB-D SLAM, our system is 6.1 times faster, and the best precision increased 30%.

articleTitle: A novel temperature drift error model for MEMS capacitive accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to enhance the temperature independence of MEMS capacitive accelerometer (MCA), a novel temperature drift error (TDE) model is proposed. On the basis of the principle of MCA, the primary cause for TDE is analyzed, and TDE model is established based on temperature variation and its square. A temperature experiment is made to test MCA, and TDE model is implemented with the test data and Back-propagation artificial neural network (BP-ANN). Then, its performance is evaluated by Mean Square Deviation (MSD), which is compared with a model based on Third-Order Least Square Method (LSM-3 model). The results show MSD compensated by TDE model is reduced more efficiently, which means TDE model can reduce TDE of MCA more accurately. It enhances the temperature independence of MCA greatly, and ensures MCA to perform stably in a long run.

articleTitle: An improved method for carrier frequency offset estimation based on FFT
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The estimation of carrier parameters is the key for coherent reception. FFT-based methods which have lower complexity, larger frequency regions and attractive performance have been widely used in practice. However, there is still much room for improvement for these traditional estimators. For example, the MSEs of traditional estimators would fluctuate dramatically while frequency varies, and they cannot adapt to higher SNR. Although iterative frequency estimator has attractive performance, it needs many times of iteration which would increase the computational complexity. An improved method is proposed in this paper. Simulation results indicate that better performance could be obtained by ingenious combination of traditional estimators.

articleTitle: Design of an indoor intelligent agent with outdoor Combi-Forklift robot as effector
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Recently, smart robots and smart systems have acquired extensive research. Combination of control engineering along with automation engineering and artificial intelligence has given birth to the next generation robotic systems and modern control engineering. Intelligent agent which is considered as the basic building block is discussed in this paper then based on the theory of artificial intelligence, image processing and control system a robotic model which is called a Combi-Forklift robot is proposed. Different kind of machines have been researched which are named as robot. Some of them contain complex mechanical structure, others contain of complex electrical circuits and some of them are designed based on extensive work of programming. Some robots recognize voice, while other recognizes the image. Some are good in audio communication and some are combined with all such properties in a human like body. Moreover, robots have been researched and designed based on application, model or domain. In this paper we have proposed a combi-forklift robot by implementing a sensor network as an agent of artificial intelligence. The sensor network acts as the intelligent interface between the human being and the robot in a way that it observes the motion and gesture of human being and communicates the commands to our designed robot in order to perform application based activities. Since the indoor sensor network based system acts as intelligent agent, therefore the outdoor combi-forklift robot acts as the effector.

articleTitle: Global fast terminal sliding mode control of space manipulator for capturing a tumbling satellite
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to capture and rescue a tumbling satellite, a space manipulator is required to track the trajectory of the capturing port of the target satellite, synchronously. This paper focuses on the control scheme of space manipulator for tracking and capturing a tumbling target satellite. First, the kinematic and dynamic equations of the space manipulator are derived, and the desired trajectory for capturing the target satellite is planned. Then, a global fast terminal sliding mode (GFTSM) control scheme is developed to enhance the system robustness against uncertainties and guarantee the tracking errors converge to the equilibriums in finite time. Furthermore, the stability of the control scheme is proved without the assumption of nonsingular inertia matrix, and the convergence time of the tracking errors is analyzed quantitatively. Finally, a numerical simulation is performed and the results verify that the GFTSM control scheme is effective for space manipulator to capture a tumbling satellite.

articleTitle: A novel MUSIC ISAR method using the first principal component
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC) Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR) algorithm is a kind of high resolution algorithm in radar imaging. Aimed at the low SNR condition and the less sampling data, this paper presents an improved MUSIC imaging algorithm using the first principal component which also can be called as first principal vector (FINE). The new algorithm is proposed to get higher quality of imaging results compared with the MUSIC algorithm and Range-Doppler algorithm in the low SNR condition. The simulation and the real data processing are presented to show the effectiveness of the new method.

articleTitle: Research on video motion characteristics extraction and description based on human visual characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet and multimedia, there is new challenge on streaming media processing and transmission. On one hand, the demand for the quantity and quality of multimedia resources are getting higher, which requires the matching capabilities of data storage and transmission. On the other hand, restricted to the computer's processing power, heterogeneous network environment, network bandwidth, terminal processing capacity and so on, the limited computing resources can only be allocated to the important visual information for analysis and processing. In order to accurately describe the important visual information, this paper proposes a video motion description method which is in line with human visual characteristics. Combined with the human visual perception characteristics and eye movement analysis, three characteristics are introduced: motion intensity, motion complexity and motion density. The dynamic characteristics of the frame is described by weighting the object and background motion vector intensities. The objective motion value can accurately reflect the human visual perception.

articleTitle: Security beamforming algorithms in multibeam satellite systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the physical layer security in a multibeam satellite communication system, where each legitimate user is surrounded by one eavesdropper. First of all, an optimization problem is formulated to maximize the sum of achievable secrecy rate, while satisfying the on-board satellite transmit power constraint. Then, two transmit beamforming(BF) schemes, namely, the zero-forcing (ZF) and the signal-to-leakage-and-noise ratio (SLNR) BF algorithms are proposed to obtain the BF weight vectors as well as power allocation coefficients. Finally, simulation results are provided to verify the validity of the two proposed methods and demonstrate that the SLNR BF algorithm outperforms the ZF BF algorithm.

Author Keywords: the sum of achievable secrecy rate

articleTitle: Research and construction of personalized user interest model for distance learning
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: User interest model is an important part of distance personalized learning, which is also the core and foundation. A good user model can reflect the preference information accurate and comprehensive, which can obtain user preference characteristics information and can reflect the real characteristics and requirements effectively. User interest model can guide users to obtain information which is in line with the characteristics of their own interest, so that the information can be more active. The construction of user interest model generally includes information collection, user interest model representation, model learning and updating. A personalized user interest model based on user attribute information and learning resources domain ontology is researched and constructed for the prediction of user behavior changes is inaccurate, algorithm space complexity is high, the analysis of the user behavior impact is not accurate and comprehensive. At last, the calculation method of model concept interest degree is researched and given.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic routing and wavelength assignment algorithm for optical networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) is one of the vital optical network issues of optical networks. With the tradeoff between the idle ratio and reliability of the candidate route, this paper researches a dynamic RWA algorithm for optical networks by introducing a factor of RWA dynamic weight to reach high demands of transmit speed and transmit quality. With the comprehensive consideration of the routing factors, i.e., idle ratio and reliability. Simulation study shows that the proposed algorithm improves the performances of network blocking ratio, packet loss ratio and link utilization greatly, and the effectiveness of the algorithm is validated.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Taylor network optimal control of aircraft flight
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper will introduce the design of the multi-dimensional Taylor network (MTN) optimal control in the flight control of aircraft. The MTN optimal control, which combines the classical architecture of feedback control system and the new controller structure, not only is suitable for the analysis of the stability of the closed-loop system, but also has advantages in the control of nonlinear systems with mechanism known or unknown models. Firstly, This paper will briefly introduce the theoretical basis of the MTN optimal control; then the characteristics of the aircraft mathematical model and the theory of aircraft control will be explained, accompanied with the design of controller; finally, the feasibility of the method is validated through numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A density-based method for selection of the initial clustering centers of K-means algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The initial clustering centers of traditional K-means algorithm are randomly generated from a data set, clustering effect is not very stable. Aimed at this problem, this paper puts forward a kind of optimal selection of the initial clustering center of K-means algorithm based on density, by calculating the local density of each data point and the minimum distance between that point and any other point with higher local density, choose K points with higher local density as the initial clustering centers. Through the UCI standard database for contrast experiment, proved that the improved K-means algorithm can eliminate the dependence on the initial clustering center, has relatively higher accuracy and stability than the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Image blurred region detection based on RGB color space information and local standard deviation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper we proposed a simple and effective method of image blurred region detection is based on RGB color space feature information and local standard deviation of image. According to re-blurred the partially blurred image by a Gaussian function, compare the difference of RGB feature information in different regions of image, and then combined with the local standard deviation of image as the blurred measures which can detect the blurred region accurately. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively detect the blurred region.

articleTitle: An embedded parallel face detection system based on multicore processor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a parallel face detection system based on multi-core processors, of which the hardware part uses the ZYNQ chips and multi-core processors and the software part includes the input and output of the image data and parallel detection. The part of parallel detection uses the cascade classifier based on MB-LBP feature and Gentle Adaboost algorithm. This system is aimed for a low-power multicore processor that is well suited to embedded system. The experimental results indicate that the parallel face detection system reduces the running time of the algorithm comparing with that on the ARM platform. Moreover, our system has outstanding performance and very high accuracy.

articleTitle: Detection of costas-encoding frequency-hopping signal based on suppressing power spectrum and pulse detection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of frequency-hopping signal detection, an improved algorithm based on power spectrum elimination and pulse detection is proposed. Firstly, judge the signal type and estimate the width of signal with the hopping frequency by STFT and pulse detection. Then, eliminate the frequency-fixed signal interfere by suppressing the signal. Finally, judge the threshold to realize the fast detection and estimate the hopping frequency. This paper is aimed at Costas-encoding frequency-hopping signals. The proposed method decreases the computation and improves the detection probability. Simulation results indicate that it can achieve a detection probability of more than 90% when SNR is above -3.7dB.

articleTitle: Duplicated record detection based on improved RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a method based on modified Radial Basis Function(RBF) neural network to improve the accuracy and recall rate for detection of duplicated records. Firstly, key fields of records are clustered by Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise(DBSCAN) and all records are classified to several classes which include duplicated records. Secondly, the similarity of corresponding fields of records in each class is computed using Jaro algorithm and duplicated records are labeled manually. Finally, Subtractive Clustering Method (SCM) and Particle Swarm Algorithm (PSO) are used to optimize the parameters of RBF neural network so that monitoring model of duplicated records is built. This method is tested with different datasets. The experimental results show that the accuracy and recall rate for the detection of duplicated records are improved significantly.

articleTitle: Study of the robust fractional order PID controller for PMSM motion control system based on differential evolution algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Combining t he analytical calculation and the Differential Evolution (DE) algorithm, a robust fractional order proportional integral derivative (PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup>) controller design strategy is proposed for a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) motion control system in this paper. Taking the robustness specification as the constraint condition, the phase margin specification and gain margin specification as t he boundary conditions, the integral of time and absolute error (ITAE) as the objective function, the robust controller parameters are obtained by applying the DE algorithm. PMSM speed tracking simulations are performed to s how t he significant advantages of using the proposed robust PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller over the traditional integer order PID controller.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Taylor network optimal control for ship roll stabilization
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Ships stability and safety are always threatened by the unavoidable sway in the complicated situation of the sea, e.g. strong wind and roaring waves. Ensuring the stability of the ship as a difficult task has received its popularities in the community in the past few decades. However, conventional control methods such as sliding mode control (SMC) and Proportional integral derivative (PID) fail to meet the requirements of the accuracy mainly because that the conventional control methods is difficult to control the trajectory tracking precisely and unable to obtain satisfactory control performance. To tackle these issues, we propose an efficient and robust ship stabilization controller based on the Multi-dimensional Taylor Network (MTN). In this paper, for the nonlinear and strong coupling ship model, we simplify the structure by a separation strategy, then design the MTN optimal controller. The simulation results show that the proposed method outperforms the conventional control approaches and can effectively control the rolling of ships.

articleTitle: Research on multi-base depth neural network speech recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In speech recognition system, an improved multi-base neural network speech recognition model is proposed to solve the problem of long learning time and slow convergence rate of deep neural network. However, the improved model introduces a large number of parameters in the training process to make the model over-fitted in the test set, resulting in the deterioration of generalization ability and the decrease of speech recognition rate. In order to solve this problem, an improved BP algorithm is introduced in the last layer of the depth neural network model. The experimental results show that the multi-base neural network model not only reduces the training time and calculation amount, but also improves the recognition accuracy compared with other recognition models, and it is an excellent speech recognition model.

articleTitle: A method of electric power consumption in household micro-grid based on energy efficiency management
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the stability of household distributed PV system and reduce the reverse power flow of low voltage, the paper proposes a kind of household micro-grid electric power consumption method based on energy efficiency management, studies the transferable and adjustment potentials of household transferable loads and temperature-controlled loads, especially analyzes the distributed PV consumption and based that builds the mathematical models of all equipment, considers multi-goal operation situations and optimizes the single-household grid electric power consumption method. Based on the optimization of algorithm cases, it demonstrates the basic methods of household micro-grid power consumption, elaborates the optimal electric power consumption strategies of single-household micro-grid in different occasions and summarizes its future development trend.

articleTitle: Improvement and implementation of quine-McCluskey algorithm for synthesis of reversible logic circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of the reversible logic synthesis, the Quine-McCluskey algorithm is improved and Implemented in this paper. By analyzing the difference and relation between the “SOP” expression and “ESOP” expression, we derived the transformation method between them and summarize the key points of the implementation of Quine-McCluskey algorithm. Additionally, the validity of the proposed method is verified by theoretical deduction and case analysis.

articleTitle: Dynamic MRI reconstruction using low-rank and 3D sparsifying transform with separation of background and dynamic components
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Dynamic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an important auxiliary diagnostic method, and higher resolution of images is more conducive to the doctor to diagnose. In this paper, we extend a method which is referred to as robust principal component analysis (RPCA) to reconstruct dynamic magnetic resonance data from under-sampled measurements based on the low-rank plus sparse decomposition model. We consider the dynamic MRI as the sum of the background and the dynamic components, where the background is enforced low-rank by a non-convex function and a 3D sparsifying transform is used to enforce sparsity in the dynamic components. The proposed optimization problem is solved based on variable splitting and alternative optimization. The results of the in-vivo dynamic cardiac dataset show the proposed method achieves superior reconstruction quality, compared to the state-of-the-art reconstruction methods.

articleTitle: Research on the blind equalization technology based on the complex BP neural network with tunable activation functions
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The blind equalization technology was proposed to reduce the inter-symbol interference (ISI) without training signal sequences. It saved the bandwidth resources and increased the correctness of signal transmissions. The blind equalizers had consequently been an indispensable part of the communication system. The blind equalization technology based on backward propagation (BP) neural networks had been widely studied with a variety of developments and improvements. In this paper, a new equalizer based on the complex BP neural networks with tunable activation functions (TAF) is proposed, algorithms were derived and simulations were done. Results showed that the proposed equalizer would work faster with less square errors than that based on traditional BP neural networks. It worked very well with zero byte-error rates (BER) when signal-to-noise (SNR) of the communication system was larger than 15 dB.

articleTitle: A research on identification method for WiFi-based home automation device suites
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: WiFi communication is widely used in home automation. In order to identify home automation device suites from the complex network environment, we employ Bi-flow model based on WiFi traffic model and combine the analysis of clustering algorithm with application-oriented algorithm of traffic identification to do the research in this paper. And then we develop a combined identification method of port number and Packet Payload Length Distribution(PPLD) aiming at the defect of the traditional methods such as statistical characteristics and the signatures of key packets. The experimental results show that the recall, precision and efficiency of the method have greatly improved comparing with the identification method of statistical characteristics and the identification method based on the signatures of key packets.

articleTitle: Intrusion detection system based on data mining for host log
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The traditional intrusion detection technology is mostly based on the needs of Web log, using a single data mining to improve the algorithm analysis, which cannot be used in an unknown environment of zero-knowledge rule database, and the efficiency of detecting the potential threats and abnormal behavior is not significant. Therefore, the Paper proposes an intrusion detection system based on data mining for host log. In the premise of zero-knowledge rule database, the combination between ARIMA time series modeling and misuse detection and the combination between Apriori association algorithm and anomaly detection effectively solve the problem of intrusion detection of host system from two dimensions of real-time detection and post detection. In this Paper, the intrusion detection system is designed, and the detection efficiency and the rate of the proposed hybrid mining pattern algorithm and the single data mining algorithm are compared. The experimental results show that the detection rate of the intrusion detection method with hybrid mining pattern is improved by 30% at least, and when the log scale is larger, the expressed detection rate is faster and the system stability is stronger.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm study on control strategy parameter optimization of hybrid powertrain system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the optimization design, the mathematical model of the control strategy parameter optimization taking the minimum fuel consumption as the objective function is established. Then, taking hybrid bulldozer as an example, the genetic algorithm is used to solve the optimization problem. Through optimization, the fuel consumption reduces 4.1% further more compared with conventional bulldozer under the same working condition. Using this method, it is easier to find a set of optimal parameters to shorten the calibrated time of the controller in a real hybrid electric vehicle.

articleTitle: The development of pneumatic stiffness-adjustable foot for bipedal robot
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The most common problem for traditional bipedal robots walking on uneven terrain is that the contact area between the soles and ground might reduce because of rigid foot soles, which will force the pose been changed and eventually cause the robots to fall. The pneumatic stiffness-adjustable foot is designed to make the walking more adaptive on uneven terrain. This foot contains a soft sole integrating new supporting airbag units underneath. The stiffness of the airbag units can be changed by internal air pressure and all the units are controlled separately. In the experiment, the interferences are added during the adaptability tests to simulate the uneven terrain and the experimental data shows that the adaptability of the foot can be improved by control of the airbag units' internal pressure.

articleTitle: Simulation and application of weak signal detection based on Chaos theory
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The extraction of weak signals from noisy backgrounds is an important part of the modern information theory. Traditional methods based on linear systems such as filtering have limitation in such applications while Chaos theory has more advantage, which becomes an important research direction. In this paper, the nonlinear chaotic Duffing oscillator is studied and simulated for its phase trajectory, noise performance, detection principle of intermittent chaos. Also the application in the density based on vibration measurement is presented. It shows chaos theory has great real application in weak signal detection.

articleTitle: FPGA-based acceleration for hyperspectral image analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: High resolution and dimensional hyperspectral data are required to develop high performance platforms for processing. FPGA provides a very effective approach for accelerating hyperspectral image analysis algorithms. In this paper, an FPGA-based acceleration flow for hyperspectral data processing is implemented, which considers the application scenario that the computer provides the hyperspectral images for FPGA and resorts to FPGA for algorithm acceleration and then fetches the results. Experimental results are shown to verify the feasibility of the flow.

articleTitle: The research of interconnection network on coarse-grained reconfigurable Cipher Logic Array
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 2nd Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Coarse-grained reconfigurable array (CGRA) has an advantage in the implementation of symmetric cryptographic algorithms with high performance and flexibility. Specially, interconnection network is used to connect each Processing Element (PE), which plays an important role in mapping performance and adaptability of algorithms. In this paper we analyze the structure of Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Cipher Logic Array (CGRCA) and extract the related demands of symmetric cryptographic algorithms, a Hierarchical Clustering Interconnection Network (HC-ICN) is proposed. Inner-cluster interconnection network has efficient and fast advantage, at the same time outer-cluster interconnection network has flexible and non-blocking advantage. To this end, the design is synthesized, experimental results shows that, compared with existing interconnection network, the proposed design has strengths in area cost, performance, flexibility and adaptability. In addition, it's of high performance in implementing several kinds of symmetric cryptographic algorithms, the throughput of Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) is up to 6.8Gbps, and the throughput of Synchronous Meteorological Satellite 4 (SM4) is up to 1.8Gbps.
